entries.title: Psalms 148:1
segments: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the heights.

entries.title: Psalms 148:2
segments: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts.

entries.title: Psalms 148:3
segments: Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all stars of light.

entries.title: Psalms 148:4
segments: Praise Him, heavens of heavens, and waters that [are] above the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 148:5
segments: Let them praise the name of the LORD; for He commanded, and they were created.

entries.title: Psalms 148:6
segments: He has also settled them forever and ever; He has made a decree which shall not pass away.

entries.title: Psalms 148:7
segments: Let praise [be to] the LORD from the earth, the sea-monsters, and all deeps;

entries.title: Psalms 148:8
segments: fire and hail, snow and vapor, stormy wind fulfilling His word,

entries.title: Psalms 148:9
segments: mountains and all hills, fruitful trees and all cedars,

entries.title: Psalms 148:10
segments: beasts and all cattle, creeping things and birds of the wing,

entries.title: Psalms 148:11
segments: kings of the earth and all people, princes and all judges of the earth,

entries.title: Psalms 148:12
segments: both young men and maidens, old men and children;

entries.title: Psalms 148:13
segments: let them praise the name of the LORD; for His name alone is excellent; His glory [is] above the earth and heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 148:14
segments: He also lifts up the horn of His people, the praise of all His saints, even of the sons of Israel, a people near to Him. Praise the LORD!
